title: HotbarSort
description: HotbarSort automatically organizes your Hotbar by saving it and loading it using simple commands
body:
### 🔄 HotbarSort

A versatile tool designed to completely swap your hotbar setup dynamically to match whatever task you are doing.

#### ✨ Key Features
* **Simple Command System:** Easily configure and trigger your hotbar layouts without complicated menus.
* **Adjustable Delay:** Features a fully customizable delay between item swaps, allowing you to fine-tune the speed to match your needs or server pacing.
* **Activity-Based Layouts:** Perfect for switching your entire focus instantly—go from a **building** layout to a **redstone** setup, or swap directly to a **combat** one .

> ⚠️ **Warning:** Please consult your server staff before using this tool. Depending on your server's rules, automated hotbar swapping or customized delay features may be considered a macro.
